result:
I committed the pre-merge resolution as `b3ed3f88d1f2`. `git merge-tree` of that commit with w2/integrate exits 0, so the CTO's later merge of integrate should have no conflict. Two parts of the brief could not be done exactly as written, and I worked around both (see work_completed and discoveries).

**Sandbox check:** passed. (a) Writing `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/.sandbox-trial-DAEO-nqa2` was refused (`OSError: [Errno 30] Read-only file system`) and no file exists. (b) `git hash-object -w --stdin` and `git update-index --refresh` both exited 0. `GOV_TICKET=DAEO-nqa2`.
**ps check:** `ps -eo pid,args | grep -iE "[o]llama|[l]lama-server"` shows nothing.

- **task:** DAEO-nqa2 (W2-90b). A pre-merge commit on w2/W2-90b so that git's own merge of w2/integrate resolves the three acceptance conflicts, without merging.
- **status:** DONE_WITH_CONCERNS. The commit is made and merges cleanly. The concerns are the two departures from the brief described below.
- **work_completed:**
  - The predecessor's scratch folder (`/tmp/gov-launch-independent-test-designer-ffkxbszq/.../d4b-w290b/`) was gone, so I rebuilt the files from RESOLUTION.md.
  - **W1-47 `w1_47_support.py`:** byte for byte integrate's file. `install_editable_gov` and `EDITABLE_PYTHON` are dropped; nothing else in the tree uses them.
  - **W2-90 `w2_90_kernel_wiring.py`:** *not* byte for byte integrate's file, as the brief asked. Integrate's file would delete this branch's other additions, which RESOLUTION.md §2 says to keep (`gov_the_pinned_line_imports`, the template readers, `w2_59_hook_project`, `w2_59_worker_project`). So the file is integrate's version plus those additions, placed after `install_gov_for`.
  - **W1-33 `test_w1_33_guard_and_launcher.py`:** no git merge can produce RESOLUTION.md's exact file. Integrate changed the signature and body of `test_the_launcher_starts_no_session_for_a_role_that_is_not_a_worker`, and the resolution changes those same lines differently, so git either conflicts or keeps integrate's text. What I did instead:
    - That case is back to the merge base's text, so integrate's rewrite (its helper, the `ready` parameter and its body) merges in unchanged.
    - The test module now has fixtures `launch` → `kernel_launch` and `project` → `kernel_project`, in lines only this branch touches. Integrate's body therefore runs on the kernel's fixtures, which has the same effect as RESOLUTION.md's body.
    - `kernel_launch` now plants the open resource gate, as RESOLUTION.md's second edit says.
  - **READMEs:** `tests/acceptance/W2-90b/README.md` lines 28 and 36 now say `plant_pinned_gov`. I re-measured the "after" row: `plant_pinned_gov` and `install_gov_for` both give a pinned line importing `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-90b/src/gov/__init__.py`. The "next round" sentence in `tests/acceptance/W2-90/README.md` now says `install_gov_for` calls `plant_pinned_gov`.
- **files_changed:**
  - `tests/acceptance/W1-33/test_w1_33_guard_and_launcher.py`
  - `tests/acceptance/W1-47/w1_47_support.py`
  - `tests/acceptance/W2-90/w2_90_kernel_wiring.py`
  - `tests/acceptance/W2-90/README.md`
  - `tests/acceptance/W2-90b/README.md`
  - Nothing else; the worktree is clean.
- **evidence:**
  - Commit `b3ed3f88d1f2`, parent `73c18fea1e1f`. It has the brief's trailers plus `Implements: DEC-1065` and `Co-Authored-By`, as EMG-d4b's commit rule asks.
  - In a scratch bare clone, `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only b3ed3f88d1f2 w2/integrate` (integrate at `7709021ad6cc`, not the `9d288f1b1c49` RESOLUTION.md measured) exits 0. Its output is one line, the tree `bc5866a9a432b02e9630ac4dcb61d29b15c37fe0`, which is the same tree the earlier trial commit gave.
  - sha256 of the merged files, also written to `/tmp/gov-launch-independent-test-designer-y0lqqsl2/claude-1000/resolved/SHA256SUMS`:
    - W1-33: `88b3eae303c7…4233`
    - W1-47: `288bbc1a94de…444e`
    - W2-90 `w2_90_kernel_wiring.py`: `993d23fd68e2…d707`
  - Suites on the branch:

    | Suite | Result |
    |---|---|
    | W1-47 | 967 passed |
    | W2-90 | no tests collected, exit 5 (the folder holds only the helper module and README) |
    | W1-33 | 107 passed, 1 skipped, 1 failed, 4 errors |

  - Suites on git's merged tree, checked out in scratch and run under a single-parent scratch commit (not a merge):

    | Suite | Result |
    |---|---|
    | W1-47 | 102 passed |
    | W2-90 | no tests collected |
    | W1-33 | 111 passed, 1 skipped |

- **tests:**
  - The 4 W1-33 errors on the branch are the three `test_the_launcher_gives_the_role_an_empty_network_profile` roles and the not-a-worker case. They fail because `support.plant_open_gate` exists only on integrate, so they can pass only after the merge; they do pass on the merged tree.
  - The 1 W1-33 failure is `test_an_install_asks_for_the_orchestrator_and_is_denied_to_every_other_role[orchestrator]` (a `deny` where `ask` was expected). This is the known red that waits for W2-105 in W2-90c.
  - Every run used the brief's `-m "not local_only" -k …` filter, `HOME` set to an empty scratch folder, and the heavy slot. That filter left out 13 W1-47 cases on the branch.
  - On the merged tree, integrate's own opt-in hook in `tests/conftest.py` also deselects cases by default: 2 in W1-33 (the orchestrator install case among them) and 872 in W1-47. That is why W1-47 runs 102 cases there instead of 967. Those cases need `--optin` or the opt-in environment variable.
- **discoveries:**
  - The brief's instruction to take integrate's `w2_90_kernel_wiring.py` byte for byte would have deleted this branch's helpers, so I did not follow it there.
  - RESOLUTION.md's exact W1-33 text cannot be what git's merge produces, so the merged file differs from it in wording. The not-a-worker case keeps integrate's text and gets the kernel fixtures through the two module fixtures.
  - Integrate moved on to `7709021ad6cc` since RESOLUTION.md was measured.
- **risks:**
  - The module-level `project` and `launch` fixtures replace the conftest's in W1-33's test module. Every case there already used the `kernel_*` fixtures, and nothing else in the module needs the conftest's versions.
  - I did not run the other suites that read `install_gov_for` (W1-05, W1-46, W1-28, W2-54, W2-59, W2-65). They now reach `plant_pinned_gov` through integrate's code, which writes the same files.
- **lessons:** a pre-merge resolution can only keep or adopt integrate's text in lines integrate changed. Branch-only intent has to go in lines integrate did not touch, here as fixture aliases.
- **proposed_decisions:** none.
- **unresolved:**
  - I didn't run the W2-90c and opt-in cases.
  - The finding in RESOLUTION.md stands: `gov accept W2-90b` reads no map in the ticket's README.
- **recommended_next_action:** the CTO merges w2/integrate into w2/W2-90b in one command. It should be conflict-free and produce git's tree `bc5866a9a432`. Then run the scoped verification, including the opt-in W1-47 and W1-33 cases, outside the sandbox.

The suite logs are in `/tmp/gov-launch-independent-test-designer-y0lqqsl2/claude-1000/runs/`. The scratch clones are `/tmp/gov-launch-independent-test-designer-y0lqqsl2/claude-1000/clone` and `/tmp/gov-launch-independent-test-designer-y0lqqsl2/claude-1000/postmerge`.
